bounties.title: Listen to Voice Clips and Label Emotions
bounties.description:
Take part in a listening study that takes about 45 minutes. Listen to English voice clips and choose the emotion and speaking-style labels that best describe each voice.

Please use headphones or work somewhere quiet, listen to every clip fully, and answer carefully.

You will receive $10 for completing the study, plus a $0.50 attention bonus if your labels match our expert labels, for careful completion and following the labeling instructions. Two practice rounds with expert feedback will show you how the task works.

After finishing the study, you must return to this task page, upload the completion code as evidence, and mark the task as complete. Both steps are required so we can review your submission and issue payment.
requirements: Comfortable understanding spoken English
Use headphones or a quiet environment
Complete the study only once
Listen fully and answer honestly
Desktop or laptop recommended
After finishing, upload the completion code as evidence and mark the task as complete on this platform

bounties.title: Clover Kingdom website feedback
bounties.description:
Wanted result: As a stranger, you open the public Clover Kingdom website and write honest first-pass feedback. No passwords, no accounts you do not need, no personal data of others.

Steps:
1. Open https://cloverkingdom.net and spend 3–5 minutes like a new visitor (desktop or phone). Click through public pages you can reach without logging in.
2. Deliver exactly these 5 bullets (plain text):
   - What confused you
   - What made you want to stay
   - What made you want to leave
   - One missing piece
   - Would you tell a friend? (yes/no + why)

Proof = your written bullets in delivery. Screenshots optional.
bounties.completionCriteria: Worker delivers exactly the 5 plain-text feedback bullets (confused / stay / leave / missing piece / tell a friend yes-no + why) after visiting cloverkingdom.net as a new visitor.

bounties.title: 3D artist / animator: review a small game's characters and animations on a web page (45 min, portfolio required)
bounties.description:
we're a tiny team making a cozy, stylised 3d browser game (chunky, soft, storybook look). we'd like a trained eye on our characters and their animations before more people play it.

who: you model or animate characters (games, film, or personal work) and can show it. IN YOUR APPLICATION: a link to your portfolio/reel (artstation, youtube, website), and one line on what you mostly do.

what to do (about 45 minutes, phone or laptop - laptop is better):
1. we send you a private link to our review page. it shows each character from all sides and each animation as a looping video with front/side frame strips.
2. for each item: tap 'looks right', or 'not right' with a short note (tap on the picture to mark the spot). skip anything you're unsure about.
3. focus on what a player would notice: clipping, sliding feet, pops at the loop, stiff or floaty motion, odd proportions, silhouettes that don't read.
4. fill in the 'overall impressions' box: the 3 biggest problems and anything that's working well.
5. tap 'done' - it shows how many items you covered.

send back: the number of items you covered and your 3 biggest problems (also in the page). honest criticism is the point.
bounties.completionCriteria: At least 60 items reviewed on the private review page with notes on any 'not right', the overall-impressions box filled (3 biggest problems + what works), and the covered count reported.

bounties.title: AI Training Collaborator – Afterquery, Handshake & More
bounties.description:
We are looking for motivated collaborators to work on AI training platforms such as Afterquery, Handshake, and similar sites. This is a part-time, long-term collaboration open to applicants worldwide.

As a collaborator, you will complete tasks assigned through these AI training platforms, which may include:
- Writing and evaluating prompts
- Labeling and annotating data
- Providing human feedback for AI model improvement (RLHF)
- Answering questions and rating AI responses
- Other platform-specific tasks

This is a flexible, remote opportunity. Specific task details and platform guidance will be discussed directly with selected candidates via chat. We are looking for reliable, detail-oriented individuals who can commit to ongoing collaboration on a per-task basis.

Reliable internet connection
Ability to work independently and part-time
Good attention to detail
Responsive and communicative via chat

This is a test/trial task to evaluate annotator quality and attention to detail before potentially moving to a larger project. You will be given a set of samples and clear annotation instructions to follow.

**What you'll be doing:**
- Annotating text snippets (e.g. sentiment, intent, entity labeling)
- Labeling images (e.g. object identification, bounding boxes, classification)
- Reviewing and tagging audio clips (e.g. transcription, speaker labels, tone)

All work is done remotely at your own pace within the 2-week deadline.

bounties.title: Refer someone to the Pier 48 sign gig — $20 per person who shows up and finishes
bounties.description:
We need sign holders at Pier 48 in San Francisco on Thursday, October 8, 4:30–7:00 PM. The shift pays $50 for about 2.5 hours. We have spots open and we're paying for help filling them.

You don't have to be in San Francisco and you don't have to work the shift yourself. This is open to everyone, anywhere.

**You earn $20 for every person you refer who shows up and completes the Thursday shift.** There's no limit on how many people you refer.

**How it works**

1. Open the Pier 48 gig page: https://rentahuman.ai/bounties/1887e308d49425024fdf
2. While signed in, tap **"Share & Earn"** on that page. That generates **your own unique referral link**.
3. Send your link to anyone in the Bay Area who'd be a good fit. It has to be your Share & Earn link — a    plain copy of the gig page URL does not get you credit.
4. When someone signs up through your link, shows up on Thursday and completes the shift, your $20 is    credited to you.

**What the shift itself involves**, so you can describe it to people: stand near the event entrance holding a sign for about 2.5 hours. The event team brings the sign and shows each person their spot. No experience needed. Easy to reach from the T line or Caltrain at 4th & King. $50 for the shift.

**Timing.** The shift is Thursday, October 8. Referrals have to land before then, and the Share & Earn button on the gig page stops working once the gig closes, so get your link now.

Nothing is owed for a referral who signs up but doesn't turn up, or who turns up and doesn't finish. The trigger is both: shows up **and** completes.
requirements: Get your own Share & Earn link from the Pier 48 gig page — a plain copy of the page URL earns nothing.
Your referral must sign up through your link, show up on Thursday Oct 8 and complete the shift.
You cannot refer yourself, and one referral per person referred.

Your job is to walk through the zoo, photograph as many animals and exhibits as possible, capturing a variety of species, behaviors, and enclosures. We're looking for clear, well-lit, and interesting shots.
